_about: Hand-edited model for porting/progress/progress.py. Leaves with a "measure" are computed; leaves with kind "manual" use the pct you set, with rationale. Weights are manual effort estimates (relative points, roughly engineer-weeks) and set the treemap area. Edit a weight or pct, commit, and the post-commit hook regenerates the dashboard. Basis ladder, most objective first: git (computed from tracked files, replayable per commit), local (computed from git-ignored outputs), documented (typed count), manual (typed percent). Denominators come from porting/progress/totals.json; checks from porting/progress/evidence.json. See README 'Objectivity audit'.
definition: 100% = the entire game can be launched into the menu, joined into a game and matchmade on the reconstructed server, and played with sound/audio and visuals 100% working. In other words: the client — the exact same client as the 12.60 original, feature-complete and unstripped, rebuilt as a UE project — reaches the lobby, matchmakes to the reconstructed UE dedicated server (which carries every structure and feature the original dedicated server would have) and plays a match with all visuals and audio. The supplied 12.60 build is the completeness reference; the original binary under Wine is an analysis oracle, not the deliverable.

milestones.text: The rebuilt client reaches the main menu with feature parity to the 12.60 original
milestones.evidence: The isolated hard-import closure reaches 721 packages with no failed/pending. UIManager class loads, but RootLayout/LoginScreen crash in original inline shader-map ABI. All 44 recovered D3D wrappers parse with exact framing; 19 have active resource-table bits (28 SRV, 18 sampler, 18 texture, zero UAV entries). All 44 translated shaders expose 180 SPIR-V descriptors in set 0, but 12 have compiler modifier diagnostics and no D3D-to-SPIR-V/UE draw mapping is verified. Inline M_UI offset 2225 versus archive Tell 2020 leaves wrapper origin/schema unresolved; no root widget or interactive menu is displayed (frontend/readiness.md, material_pipeline/README.md, HANDOFF.md).

milestones.text: The client joins a lobby on the reconstructed server
milestones.evidence: Native client/server direct joins pass, including an Athena pawn and network checksum 683914758. The last full regression reports 4,617 of 4,617 generated classes matching the offline checksum model; this does not establish runtime wire parity or a rebuilt-client lobby (native_classes_status.md).

milestones.text: The client matchmakes to the reconstructed UE dedicated server
milestones.evidence: Ticket, websocket, session and key routes exist; 71 backend tests passed in the last full regression. The client response parser has been located and session-key and websocket responses corrected; response shapes remain partly inferred and no rebuilt-client end-to-end matchmaking run is recorded (server/EVIDENCE.md).

milestones.text: A full match is played with audio and visuals working
milestones.evidence: No Fortnite gameplay runs; audio playback is untested; the Apollo island is incomplete (map_compatibility.md).

children.name: Native UE 4.25 Linux build, cook and stage
children.rationale: The build, cook and stage path runs end to end. Measured from committed targets and ignored local build outputs.

children.name: Wine analysis oracle: original client reaches the login screen
children.rationale: The six ledger checks record Wine engine start, pak mount, Frontend map, login screen, AppES entitlement and lobby map. A stage without a passing record counts as 0. The observed Wine run stopped at the AppES access gate; later stages remain unverified.

children.name: Wine analysis oracle: original client engine start
children.rationale: The ledger records whether the original client under Wine initializes its engine using the existing launch script. This does not establish access beyond the observed AppES gate or native client functionality.

children.name: Rendering backend on Linux (Vulkan)
children.rationale: Software Vulkan (Lavapipe) runs with swapchain and visual captures of terrain, sky and background, but only software rendering has been tested and Fortnite shaders and materials are mostly absent. No objective metric yet: no capture set is compared against the original client's frames.

children.name: Pak index decryption and parse (31 paks)
children.rationale: All 31 pak indexes were decrypted and validated (README.md). The count comes from the local inventory.

children.name: Map header parse (3,694 maps)
children.rationale: Every cooked map header was parsed for native imports. Counted from the local census rows; the denominator is the 3,694 World assets in the asset registry (totals.json).

children.name: Package recovery and conversion coverage (incl. textures and materials)
children.rationale: Share of the distinct cooked .uasset entries in the verified full extraction of all 31 paks (450,951; totals.json cooked_uasset_entries) that exist locally, either recovered (generated/extracted) or converted (native/Content). This leaf is about the converted/usable closure, not raw extraction: raw extraction of every pak is tracked by assets.pak_extraction. This tile absorbs the former assets.textures (weight 20) and assets.materials (weight 25) leaves, whose done signals were the same 'packages present locally' measure. Counted from ignored local folders.

children.name: Raw pak extraction (all 31 paks)
children.rationale: Files present in the verified full raw extraction of all 31 paks (/mnt/vibrato/fortnite-extracted-full), counted from the verified summary's verification.treeFiles, against the 963,427 distinct pak paths (totals.json pak_full_distinct_paths, from the same summary's uniquePaths). The summary is written by the extraction's verify mode (extraction_status.md), so the post-commit hook never walks the million files. Counts raw extraction only, not conversion.

children.name: Static meshes converted for Linux
children.rationale: Counted: every .glb conversion under generated/converted (61 Apollo grid tiles, Background, skybox and cloud meshes) plus SM_ packages in native/Content, de-duplicated by name. Denominator: 4,727 distinct SM_-named cooked packages (full 31-pak tree, refresh_totals.py --count-tree). The SM_ rule is a naming heuristic, and the glb conversions are counted whatever their names, so this is a coverage ratio, not an exact asset count.

children.name: Landscape weightmaps and streamed components
children.rationale: 221 landscape components are decoded, but only in the A1-H8 grid export (61 tiles; A7 and A8 absent, B8 has no components). Streaming landscape levels and the parent level still fail on missing classes. Not measured: the full 31-pak tree has 67 Apollo_Terrain_LS tile packages (.umap), and components are stored inside those tiles, not as one package each, so there is no cooked component count to use as a denominator; 64 .uasset basenames contain 'landscape' but none is a component package. Kept manual at 15 with the same ceiling.

children.name: Skeletal meshes, animation and character
children.rationale: Counted: SK_ skeletal mesh packages converted in native/Content (none). Denominator: 1,719 distinct SK_-named cooked packages (naming heuristic, totals.json). No skeletal mesh or animation package has loaded in any probe. Animation sequences (A_, 7 names) are too few to matter and are not counted separately.

children.name: Cooked Blueprint packages load
children.rationale: Four Apollo Blueprint packages were replaced by authored Blueprints that load (typed count, documented). The denominator is the 22,211 Blueprint assets in the asset registry (totals.json). The original cooked gameplay Blueprints still crash on load.

children.name: Cinematics and sequences
children.rationale: No level sequence or cinematic asset has been tested. No objective metric yet: the registry summary has no level-sequence count, and cooked 'Sequence' names are mostly curves.

children.name: Native reflection recovery from the decrypted exe (names, parents, structs, enums)
children.rationale: Class names recovered for 6,957 of the 6,967 UHT class blocks (class_name_map.json over the block total in totals.json). Measures recovery of the names, not rebuilt behaviour. Structs (4,512), enums (2,056) and delegates (1,515) are recovered too but not counted here. Parents are verified at 99.76% against UE 4.25 headers (binary_analysis.md). Ten blocks remain unnamed.

children.name: Maps that enter play in the Linux runtime
children.rationale: FortniteEmptyDedicated and Skybox_Outpost_HomeBase enter play (typed count, documented). The denominator is the 3,694 World assets in the asset registry (totals.json). The partial Apollo_Terrain is not counted, since it lacks streamed levels.

children.name: Apollo terrain tiles (geometry and collision)
children.rationale: All 61 nonempty tiles are converted with collision and visual proxy atlases. The count is capped at 35 because original materials, landscape fidelity and streamed levels are unverified.

children.name: Apollo_Background meshes and placements
children.rationale: 27 of 32 placements spawn as replicated native actors. The count is capped at 30 because the meshes are placeholders and visual parity is unverified. Placements are recorded in the converted list.

children.name: Sky, clouds and backdrop
children.rationale: A sky atmosphere replaces the black background. A simplified cloud and three backdrop materials render. The aurora and the Fortnite sky system are absent. No objective metric yet: no sky or cloud render is captured and compared with the original.

children.name: Apollo streamed levels (87)
children.rationale: None of the 87 streamed levels load (typed count, documented). The denominator is the figure in the tracked map_compatibility.md report (totals.json).

children.name: POIs and POI maps
children.rationale: The POI Blueprints fail while their cooked scripts load. The POI manager is an empty native class. No objective metric yet: no POI map enters play, so there is nothing to count.

children.name: Weapons and firing
children.rationale: Done: tracked reflection-exact class headers under Source/FortniteGame/Generated whose name matches Weapon. Total: named /Script/FortniteGame classes matching the same regex (totals.json). The census cannot measure this group because no weapon class is imported by a map header. No weapon behaviour is reproduced. Capped at 20%, the same credit the model gives any declared-but-behaviourless class, because generated class headers carry no behaviour and are already counted under gameplay.reflection_exact; the cap lifts as ported function bodies (gameplay.native_behavior) cover these classes.

children.name: Storm and safe zone
children.rationale: Done: tracked reflection-exact class headers whose name matches Storm or SafeZone. Total: named /Script/FortniteGame classes matching the same regex (totals.json). FortSafeZoneStorm exists as an empty native stub, which is not counted as behaviour. Capped at 20%, the same credit the model gives any declared-but-behaviourless class, because generated class headers carry no behaviour and are already counted under gameplay.reflection_exact; the cap lifts as ported function bodies (gameplay.native_behavior) cover these classes.

children.name: Battle bus, skydiving and gliding
children.rationale: Done: tracked reflection-exact class headers whose name matches BattleBus, Aircraft, Parachute or Glider. Total: named /Script/FortniteGame classes matching the same regex (totals.json). No battle bus or glider behaviour exists. The skydiving shadow proxy stub is visual only and is counted under visuals. Capped at 20%, the same credit the model gives any declared-but-behaviourless class, because generated class headers carry no behaviour and are already counted under gameplay.reflection_exact; the cap lifts as ported function bodies (gameplay.native_behavior) cover these classes.

children.name: Blueprint gameplay logic (behaviour, not load)
children.rationale: No original Blueprint behaviour has been reproduced. cue4inspect pseudocode is partial and unresolved. No objective metric yet: no Blueprint behaviour is reproduced, and no metric counts it.

children.name: Reflection-exact native classes (/Script/FortniteGame, generated)
children.rationale: Done: tracked class headers under Source/FortniteGame/Generated over named FortniteGame classes (totals.json). Header counts measure declarations, not implemented behavior or runtime wire compatibility.

children.name: Native function bodies ported (behaviour)
children.rationale: Done: committed .inc function bodies under porting/behavior, one per ported function. Total: native functions with an execution address in the decompiled image (native_funcs.json, totals.json). Only committed bodies count. An honest small percentage is expected while the port is at the reflection stage. Counts ported FUNCTIONS (manifest entries with status 'ported', written by porting/behavior/check_behavior.py to COUNTS.txt), not snippet files: two shared bodies serve 123 trivial validate/empty-implementation functions. Trivial bodies count the same as large ones here; the breakdown by kind is in porting/behavior/MANIFEST.json.

children.rationale: Documented as required in original_client_net_protocol.md. Not exercised against the original client.

children.name: AES and Oodle packet handler configuration
children.rationale: Configuration strings are in place. The handshake has not been exercised with the original client.

children.name: Encryption token delegate and key route

checks.label: Session key route answered by server

children.rationale: Hooks are declared. Key validity is not tested against the client.

children.name: Native client joins native dedicated server
children.rationale: Ledger: a native client joins the native dedicated server on the default and Athena maps (porting/server/smoke_join.sh) and the server log shows the network version checksum 683914758. Recorded with record_evidence.py; the latest result per check counts. Says nothing about the original client (see net.original_join).

children.name: Original client joins the reconstructed server
children.rationale: The ledger currently measures original-client entitlement and lobby log stages, not a server join. The observed Wine run stopped at the AppES access gate; Hello, Login, Welcome and Join have not been verified against the original client.

children.name: Replicated class layout parity
children.rationale: Property order, RPC index and struct layouts must match the original. Only the native stubs exist, and their property sets are not recovered. No objective metric yet: layout parity needs the original's per-property offsets, and the checksum leaf covers only the hash.

children.name: Class checksum parity
children.rationale: The tracked class checksum report measures an offline comparison of generated headers against recovered reflection tables over named native classes. The last full regression reported 4,617 of 4,617 generated classes matching; this is not a live wire compatibility test.

children.name: Server replication graph
children.rationale: The original server replication graph is server-only and not started. No objective metric yet: nothing about the server replication graph is reproduced or measured.

children.name: Version check and lightswitch
children.rationale: Committed server code only. Uncommitted stubs do not count. Answers are canned.

children.name: OAuth and account routes
children.rationale: Route coverage by prefix: the template's literal path must appear in committed server code. Canned responses are credited at 50%.

children.name: Matchmaking ticket and session routes
children.rationale: Ticket, session and account key routes. No websocket and no session flow exist yet.

children.name: Game v2 profile, world, chat and voice routes
children.rationale: Profile, world, enabled features, chat, voice and twitch routes. Only the stub answers exist.

children.name: Public catalog, payment and asset routes
children.rationale: Store, asset, lookup and payment routes. No real catalog behaviour is reproduced.

children.name: Party and XMPP

checks.label: Party or XMPP referenced in committed server code

children.rationale: XMPP is a large extra backend (original_client_net_protocol.md section 3). Nothing is implemented.

children.name: Party and lobby beacons, session discovery

checks.label: Session discovery route (matchmaking session record) referenced

children.rationale: Measured by checks now that the session discovery route formats and the BeaconPort attribute are evidenced in the binary (see porting/server/EVIDENCE.md). Beacon hosts are UE net-driver code in the native server (AOnlineBeaconHost, AFortPartyBeaconHost), not HTTP routes, so no backend check can show them. The ceiling of 10 keeps the leaf at the session-discovery share.

children.name: Stats, events, cloud storage and datarouter
children.rationale: Only canned empty responses exist for these routes.

children.name: Sound classes and mixes load
children.rationale: Only Master.Master is logged as loaded (typed count, documented, asset_compatibility.md). The denominator is the 317 cooked sound class and mix package paths (totals.json, path heuristic). The documented 306 packages in FortSoundClassesAndModes and SoundClasses are a subset of that set; mixes beyond that have not been checked.

children.name: Audio playback on the Linux runtime
children.rationale: Every probe ran with -nosound. No audio device output has been heard or measured. No objective metric yet: every probe ran with -nosound, so there is no audio output to count.

children.name: Sound cues, music and ambience
children.rationale: No cue or music asset has been played back. No objective metric yet: no cue or music asset has been played back, and no cue count is converted.

children.name: Voice chat
children.rationale: Voice routes from the static client scan (routes.json) whose literal path appears in committed server code, credited at 50%. None of the voice routes is implemented.

children.name: Lighting and shadows
children.rationale: A sun light and a temporary replicated light exist. The shadow proxy Blueprint is not recovered. No objective metric yet: lighting parity needs captures compared against the original, and none exist.

children.name: Post-process and renderer settings parity
children.rationale: Fortnite post-process and renderer configuration is not reproduced. No objective metric yet: no post-process setting is captured or compared with the original.

children.name: VFX, particles and Niagara
children.rationale: Counted: NS_ Niagara packages converted in native/Content or generated/converted (none). Denominator: 173 distinct NS_-named cooked packages (naming heuristic, totals.json, full 31-pak tree). Particle (Cascade) assets are not counted. No Niagara or particle asset has loaded.

children.name: UMG and CommonUI native modules
children.rationale: Done: tracked reflection-exact class headers for CommonUI and UMG (no UMG headers are generated). Total: named classes in /Script/CommonUI and /Script/UMG (totals.json). A 64x64 UI texture loads. No widget is loaded: a UI Blueprint fails on a missing CommonButton function, and no CommonUI behaviour runs. Capped at 20%, the same credit the model gives any declared-but-behaviourless class, because generated class headers carry no behaviour and are already counted under gameplay.reflection_exact; the cap lifts as ported function bodies (gameplay.native_behavior) cover these classes.

children.name: Frontend menus and lobby flow
children.rationale: No main menu, lobby or matchmaking UI is reproduced. No objective metric yet: no menu or lobby widget is reproduced, and the widget Blueprints are not mapped to menus.

children.name: In-match HUD
children.rationale: No HUD is reproduced. No objective metric yet: no HUD widget is reproduced or captured.

children.name: /Script/FortniteUI native classes
children.rationale: Done: tracked reflection-exact class headers under Source/FortniteUI/Generated. Total: named /Script/FortniteUI classes (totals.json). No FortniteUI module is generated yet. ui_audio_census.md covers the widget side.
